title.zh: Layer 1 公链 Fogo 遭攻击者获取 4 亿 FOGO 代币后暂停主网
title.en: Layer 1 blockchain Fogo halts mainnet after attacker receives 400 million FOGO tokens

summary.zh:
2026 年 8 月 29 日，Fogo 在攻击者获取 4 亿枚 FOGO 代币后暂停了主网。该数量约占流通供应量的 10%，当时价值约 300 万美元。

Layer 1 区块链因代币被盗事件而暂停主网，是严重的安全与信任事件，会影响 Fogo 上的用户、验证者和 DeFi 应用。尽管与大型攻击事件相比美元金额不大，但此次停机凸显了供应层面的漏洞如何能够扰乱网络运行。

被盗的 4 亿枚 FOGO 代币约占流通供应量的 10%，约占 FOGO 创世供应量的 4%。事发时这些代币价值约 300 万美元。
summary.en:
On August 29, 2026, Fogo halted its mainnet after an attacker obtained 400 million FOGO tokens, about 10% of circulating supply and worth roughly $3 million.

A Layer 1 blockchain pausing its mainnet over a token-theft incident is a serious security and trust event, affecting users, validators, and DeFi applications built on Fogo. Although the dollar value is modest compared with major exploits, the shutdown highlights how supply-level vulnerabilities can disrupt network operations.

The stolen 400 million FOGO tokens represent about 10% of the circulating supply and roughly 4% of FOGO's genesis supply. At the time of the incident, the tokens were valued at about $3 million.

title.zh: 腾讯开源新一代 Hy4 Preview，7700亿参数 MoE 模型
title.en: Tencent Open-Sources Hy4 Preview, a 770B-Parameter MoE Model

summary.zh:
腾讯发布并开源了新一代混合专家（MoE）大语言模型 Hy4 preview，总参数量达7700亿，激活参数为490亿。该模型在 OpenRouter 上线后迅速获得大量使用，数天内处理了数万亿 token。

这是来自顶级实验室的重大开源 AI 发布，加剧了开放权重模型之间的竞争。Hy4 的递归自我改进实验和 OpenRouter 上的快速采用，可能加速开源 AI 生态的发展，并影响开发者的选择。

Hy4 preview 采用混合专家架构，总参数7700亿，激活参数490亿，支持超过100万 token 的上下文窗口。腾讯表示，该模型参与了自身训练方法、数据策略、评估框架和底层算子的自动化优化，形成了早期的递归自我改进循环。
summary.en:
Tencent released and open-sourced Hy4 preview, a next-generation Mixture-of-Experts LLM with 770B total parameters and 49B active parameters. The model quickly gained traction on OpenRouter, processing trillions of tokens within days of release.

This is a major open-source AI release from a top-tier lab, intensifying competition among open-weights models. Hy4's recursive self-improvement experiments and rapid OpenRouter adoption could accelerate progress in the open-source AI ecosystem and shape developer preferences.

Hy4 preview uses a Mixture-of-Experts architecture with 770B total and 49B active parameters, and supports a context window exceeding 1M tokens. Tencent says the model participated in optimizing its own training methods, data strategies, evaluation frameworks, and low-level operators, forming an early recursive self-improvement loop.

title.zh: OpenAI 在 SpaceX 收购后切断与 Cursor 的合作，称与 xAI 冲突
title.en: OpenAI cuts off Cursor after SpaceX acquisition, citing xAI conflict

summary.zh:
OpenAI 宣布，在 Cursor 被 SpaceXAI（原 xAI）收购后，将停止向这款 AI 编程编辑器提供其模型。该决定于 2026 年 8 月做出，理由是存在与 xAI 的冲突以及对模型蒸馏的担忧。

此举重塑了 AI 编程工具生态，将 OpenAI 模型从最广泛使用的 AI 集成开发环境之一中移除。这标志着 AI 实验室愿意切断与竞争对手关联工具的合作，可能促使开发者转向 GitHub Copilot、Claude Code 或独立的开源模型等替代方案。

这一决定源于埃隆·马斯克承认 Grok 部分是通过蒸馏 OpenAI 模型开发的，这违反了典型的服务条款。Anthropic 今年早些时候曾因类似违规行为禁止 xAI，但目前尚不清楚 Anthropic 是否会将禁令延伸到 Cursor。
summary.en:
OpenAI announced it will stop providing its models to Cursor, an AI coding editor, after Cursor was acquired by SpaceXAI (formerly xAI). The decision, made in August 2026, cites conflicts with xAI and concerns over model distillation.

This move reshapes the AI coding tool ecosystem, removing OpenAI models from one of the most widely used AI IDEs. It signals that AI labs are willing to sever ties with tools associated with rivals, potentially driving developers toward alternatives like GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or standalone open-source models.

The decision follows Elon Musk's admission that Grok was partly developed via distillation from OpenAI models, which violates typical terms of service. Anthropic had previously banned xAI for similar violations earlier in the year, though it remains unclear whether Anthropic will extend that ban to Cursor.

title.zh: Deribit将90%客户资产转至Coinbase，取消每日储备证明
title.en: Deribit Moves 90% of Client Assets to Coinbase, Drops Daily Proof of Reserves

summary.zh:
Deribit将于9月1日因与Coinbase整合而移除公开的储备证明页面，并表示约90%的客户资产已转入Coinbase托管。此举取消了客户每日对余额的默克尔验证。

此举降低了这家大型加密衍生品交易所的公开透明度，取消了用户每日独立核查偿付能力的工具。尽管迪拜VARA仍要求储备、对账和审计，但验证方式从每日公开检查转向频率更低、需申请才能获得的披露。

Deribit现有系统使用保护隐私的二叉默克尔树和每日快照，让客户能验证自己的余额，并将总负债与公布的持币地址进行比较。该交易所未承诺提供替代仪表盘或继续客户级默克尔验证，其方法此前已排除Copper ClearLoop等第三方托管资产。
summary.en:
Deribit will remove its public Proof of Reserves page on Sept. 1 as part of its Coinbase integration, saying roughly 90% of client assets have been moved into Coinbase custody. The removal eliminates daily client-level Merkle verification of balances.

The move reduces public transparency for one of the largest crypto derivatives exchanges, removing a daily tool users could use to independently check solvency. Although Dubai's VARA still mandates reserves, reconciliation, and audits, the change shifts verification from daily public checks to less frequent, request-based disclosures.

Deribit's existing system used a privacy-preserving binary Merkle tree and daily snapshot, letting clients verify their balances and compare aggregate liabilities with published wallet holdings. The exchange has not promised a replacement dashboard or continued client-level Merkle verification, and its methodology already excluded third-party custodians such as Copper ClearLoop.

title.zh: Cosmos Labs承认误判漏洞，致六链遭570万美元攻击
title.en: Cosmos Labs admits fault in clearing bug behind $5.7M six-chain hack

summary.zh:
Cosmos Labs承认，它错误放行了导致六个区块链遭570万美元攻击的关键漏洞，其中MANTRA Chain损失360万美元。MANTRA Chain称补丁在攻击发生前20小时才发布，且未指明所修复的缺陷。

该事件暴露出Cosmos生态在漏洞审查方面的重大缺陷，并可能削弱人们对跨链基础设施安全性的信任。由于攻击波及多条链上的用户资金，这引发对基于IBC的互操作安全以及核心开发团队责任感的担忧。

该攻击影响了六条链，其中MANTRA Chain损失约360万美元。MANTRA Chain表示，补丁在攻击前20小时才发布，且没有指明其要修复的缺陷。
summary.en:
Cosmos Labs has admitted it mistakenly cleared the critical vulnerability that enabled a $5.7 million exploit across six blockchains, with MANTRA Chain suffering $3.6 million in losses. The admission comes after MANTRA Chain claimed the patch was released only 20 hours before the attack began.

This incident exposes a significant flaw in vulnerability review within the Cosmos ecosystem, potentially undermining trust in the security of cross-chain infrastructure. Since the exploit affected user funds across multiple chains, it raises concerns about the safety of IBC-based interoperability and the accountability of core developers.

The exploit affected six chains, including an estimated $3.6 million loss for MANTRA Chain. MANTRA Chain said the patch did not identify the flaw it was meant to fix, and was released only 20 hours before the attack began.

title.zh: 特朗普推广品牌的GOLD代币在团队抛售后暴跌99%
title.en: Trump-Promoted Brand's GOLD Token Collapses 99% After Team Sell-Off

summary.zh:
一款名为“Trump Digital GOLD”的Solana链上代币经特朗普关联品牌Real Trump Coins的X账号推广后，在数小时内暴跌约99%。区块链数据分析平台Lookonchain报告称，15个与团队相关的钱包抛售了2.245亿枚GOLD，换取约3,178枚SOL（约33万美元），相关推广帖随后被删除。

这一事件凸显了与名人及政客挂钩的迷因币的风险——内部人员抛售可在数小时内让散户投资者血本无归。在特朗普政府推动国会重塑加密监管之际，此事也加剧了对特朗普关联加密项目的审视。

Lookonchain指出，代币开发者持有6亿枚GOLD，而15个新建钱包花费18,657美元购买了另外2.245亿枚代币，使团队控制了总供应量约82.45%。这15个钱包将全部GOLD卖出换取3,178枚SOL（约33万美元）后，代币市值从约5,000万美元跌至50万美元。Real Trump Coins网站仍在推广GOLD，宣传4%的交易费，并承诺将99%的交易费用于回购。
summary.en:
A Solana-based token called 'Trump Digital GOLD' was promoted by the Trump-linked Real Trump Coins X account and collapsed about 99% within hours, after blockchain analytics firm Lookonchain reported that 15 team-linked wallets dumped 224.5 million GOLD tokens for roughly 3,178 SOL (~$330,000). The promotional posts were later deleted from X.

The episode highlights the risks of celebrity- and politician-linked memecoins, where insider dumping can wipe out retail investors within hours. It also intensifies scrutiny of Trump-associated crypto ventures while the administration pushes Congress to reshape crypto regulation.

Lookonchain noted the token developer held 600 million GOLD while 15 newly created wallets spent $18,657 to buy another 224.5 million tokens, giving the team roughly 82.45% of the total supply. After the 15 wallets sold all of their GOLD for 3,178 SOL (~$330,000), the token's market capitalization fell from about $50 million to $500,000; the Real Trump Coins website still promoted GOLD with a 4% trading fee and a pledge to use 99% of fees for buybacks.

title.zh: Polygon Labs 敦促节点在 Austin 与 Kyoto 硬分叉后升级
title.en: Polygon Labs Urges Node Upgrades After Austin, Kyoto Hardforks

summary.zh:
Polygon Labs 发布紧急通知，要求 Polygon PoS 节点运营者在 Austin 和 Kyoto 硬分叉激活后将 Bor 升级到 v2.10.0 或更高版本，并将 Heimdall 升级到 v0.11.0 或更高版本。仍然运行硬分叉前二进制的节点已经脱离规范共识，必须追赶同步后才能重新加入网络。

这次升级对于所有希望保持共识的 Polygon PoS 节点都是强制性的，因此对验证者和基础设施提供商至关重要。它还带来了安全加固修复，降低了资源耗尽和活性风险，为网络后续的架构转型打下更坚实的基础。

Austin 限制了 Bor 处理状态同步桥接事件时的 gas 消耗，并移除了无大小限制的 TxDependency 附加数据字段；Kyoto 则增加了对 protobuf.Any 消息的嵌套检查、限制了 fee-coin 列表，并修复了多个检查点和签名边界情况。两个硬分叉均为纯二进制升级，无状态迁移，因此未发生分叉的节点无需重新同步。
summary.en:
Polygon Labs issued an urgent notice requiring Polygon PoS node operators to upgrade Bor to v2.10.0 or later and Heimdall to v0.11.0 or later after the Austin and Kyoto hardforks activated. Nodes that remained on pre-hardfork binaries have already fallen out of canonical consensus and must catch up to rejoin the network.

The upgrade is mandatory for all Polygon PoS nodes that want to stay in consensus, making it critical for validators and infrastructure providers. It also ships security hardening fixes that reduce resource-exhaustion and liveness risks, strengthening the network ahead of further architectural transitions.

Austin capped gas consumption during Bor's processing of state-sync bridge events and removed the unbounded TxDependency extra-data field, while Kyoto added nesting checks for protobuf.Any messages, capped fee-coin lists, and fixed several checkpoint and signature edge cases. Both hardforks are plain binary upgrades with no state migration, so non-diverged nodes do not need a resync.

title.zh: DHS利用鲜为人知的1509传票秘密获取记者和非营利组织通讯记录
title.en: DHS Uses Obscure 1509 Summons to Secretly Obtain Records of Journalists and Nonprofits

summary.zh:
美国国土安全部（DHS）一直在利用一种鲜为人知的行政传票“1509 summons”秘密获取记者、非营利组织和工会的电话及通信记录，并且在受到挑战时常常撤回传票，以避免法院对其合法性作出裁决。

这种做法引发严重的第四修正案担忧，因为传票无需法官监督即可签发，使政府得以绕过正常的搜查令程序。它影响新闻自由、隐私权，以及倡导团体在不惧怕政府监控的情况下开展活动的能力。

1509传票是一种行政传票，按美国法典第19篇的规定，仅用于调查非法进口或未缴关税。在一起案例中，DHS从T-Mobile获取了某记者六个月的电话记录，包含超过1万通电话和短信，直到数月后才通知她本人。
summary.en:
The Department of Homeland Security has been using an obscure administrative subpoena known as a 1509 summons to secretly obtain phone and communication records of journalists, non-profits, and unions, often withdrawing the summons once challenged in court to avoid a ruling on its legality.

This practice raises serious Fourth Amendment concerns because the summons is issued without a judge's oversight, allowing the government to bypass the normal warrant process. It affects press freedom, privacy rights, and the ability of advocacy groups to operate without fear of government surveillance.

The 1509 summons is an administrative subpoena intended exclusively for investigations of illegal imports or unpaid customs duties under Title 19 of the U.S. Code. In one case, DHS obtained six months of phone records from T-Mobile for a journalist, including more than 10,000 calls and text messages, without notifying her until months later.

title.zh: 面对加密等奇特ETF提案，美国SEC审查自动申报通道
title.en: SEC Reviews Automatic ETF Filing Pathways Amid Exotic Crypto Proposals

summary.zh:
美国证券交易委员会（SEC）于6月30日发布概念文件，就自动ETF申报通道能否充分处理加密资产、事件关联合约、杠杆策略和私募资产等奇特产品征求公众意见，意见反馈截止日期为8月31日。

此次审查可能重塑美国对加密和事件关联ETF的批准与监管方式，影响产品复杂性、托管、流动性和估值要求。它表明SEC正在审视熟悉的ETF代码是否掩盖了日益陌生的风险——美国ETF资产规模已从4万亿美元增长到12万亿美元。

2019年通过的6c-11规则允许符合1940年法案条件的ETF无需逐一申请豁免令即可推出，促使产品数量翻倍至4,600多只。SEC正在审查现有员工权限和审查时间是否足以应对比特币和以太坊现货商品信托结构、交易所交易票据（ETN）以及其他非1940年法案工具。
summary.en:
The SEC issued a June 30 concept release requesting public comment on whether its automatic ETF filing pathways can adequately handle exotic products, including crypto assets, event-linked contracts, leveraged strategies, and private assets. Comments are due August 31.

The review could reshape how crypto and event-linked ETFs are approved and regulated in the US, affecting product complexity, custody, liquidity, and valuation requirements. It signals that the SEC is scrutinizing whether familiar ETF tickers are masking unfamiliar risks as assets under management in US ETFs grew from $4 trillion to $12 trillion.

Rule 6c-11, adopted in 2019, let qualifying ETFs under the 1940 Act launch without individual exemptive orders, helping the product count more than double to over 4,600. The SEC is examining whether existing staff authority and review time are sufficient for spot Bitcoin and Ethereum commodity-trust structures, exchange-traded notes, and other non-1940-Act vehicles.

title.zh: 曼彻斯特机场集团遭网络攻击，870万客户记录泄露
title.en: Manchester Airports Group Cyberattack Exposes 8.7 Million Customer Records

summary.zh:
曼彻斯特机场集团（MAG）遭受网络攻击，导致约870万条客户记录泄露，专家正在分析此次入侵的方式以及泄露的数据内容。

此次泄露事件波及英国一家主要机场运营商，可能影响数百万旅客的个人数据。它也凸显了关键基础设施和大型客户数据库在网络威胁面前的持续脆弱性。

据报道，泄露的记录包含MAG机场运营的客户数据。专家正在分析攻击方式和受影响的具体信息类型，但官方尚未完全确认数据范围。
summary.en:
Manchester Airports Group (MAG) suffered a cyberattack that exposed approximately 8.7 million customer records, prompting expert analysis of how the breach occurred and what data was compromised.

The breach affects a major UK airport operator, potentially impacting millions of travelers' personal data. It highlights the persistent vulnerability of critical infrastructure and large customer databases to cyber threats.

The exposed records reportedly include customer data from MAG's airport operations. Experts are examining the attack method and the specific types of information compromised, though official confirmations of the full data scope remain limited.

title.zh: 加密卡遭黑客攻击损失110万美元，新银行代币暴跌49%
title.en: Crypto Card Hack Drains $1.1M, Crashes Neobank Token 49%

summary.zh:
据2026年8月29日的报道，一起利用加密卡进行、造成110万美元损失的黑客攻击，导致一家新银行（neobank）的代币暴跌49%。

该事件凸显了加密支付基础设施中的安全漏洞，并表明安全漏洞能多快侵蚀信任和代币价值。它也提醒人们注意整合加密货币服务的数字优先银行所面临的风险。

此次黑客攻击专门针对加密借记卡，造成110万美元损失。该新银行的代币下跌49%，反映出市场对此次安全事件的严重反应。
summary.en:
A $1.1 million hack exploiting a crypto card caused a neobank's token to plummet 49%, according to a report on August 29, 2026.

The incident highlights security vulnerabilities in crypto payment infrastructure and shows how quickly a security breach can erode trust and token value. It underscores the risks faced by digital-first banks that integrate crypto services.

The hack specifically targeted a crypto debit card, resulting in $1.1 million in losses. The neobank's token dropped 49%, reflecting a severe market reaction to the breach.

title.zh: Polygon披露Austin与Kyoto硬分叉修复的安全漏洞
title.en: Polygon discloses security flaws fixed in Austin and Kyoto hard forks

summary.zh:
Polygon Labs披露了此前未公开的、影响Bor和Heimdall客户端的安全漏洞，这些漏洞已在公开披露前通过Austin和Kyoto硬分叉悄悄修复。漏洞包括拒绝服务风险、验证人资源耗尽以及检查点和里程碑处理问题。

此次披露意义重大，因为它揭示了Polygon的权益证明网络曾面临可能破坏共识的严重稳定性威胁。同时，它也凸显了及时打补丁的重要性，因为运行旧版客户端的节点已经无法参与共识。

最严重的问题出在Heimdall，精心构造的交易可迫使验证人执行过多处理工作。现在所有Polygon PoS节点都需要Bor v2.10.0，验证人和全节点需要Heimdall v0.11.0；两项升级均已在主网生效。
summary.en:
Polygon Labs disclosed previously private security vulnerabilities in its Bor and Heimdall clients that were silently patched via the Austin and Kyoto hard forks before public disclosure. The flaws included denial-of-service risks, validator resource exhaustion, and checkpoint/milestone processing issues.

This disclosure matters because it reveals that Polygon's proof-of-stake network faced serious stability threats that could have disrupted consensus. It also underscores the importance of timely patching, since nodes running older client versions have already fallen out of consensus.

The most severe issue was in Heimdall, where a specially crafted transaction could force validators to do excessive processing work. Bor v2.10.0 is now required for all Polygon PoS nodes, and Heimdall v0.11.0 is required for validators and full nodes; both upgrades are already active on mainnet.

title.zh: Strategy 面临被剔出 MSCI 全球股票指数的新威胁
title.en: Strategy Faces Fresh Threat of Removal from MSCI Global Equity Indexes

summary.zh:
据2026年8月29日的报道，Strategy（NASDAQ: MSTR）面临被剔除出MSCI全球股票指数的新威胁。若被剔除，跟踪这些指数的被动基金将被迫卖出其持有的MSTR股票。

MSCI全球股票指数被全球机构投资者用于基准分析和资产配置。若被剔除，被动基金将被迫卖出，给作为比特币代理股的MSTR带来下行压力，并可能抑制加密货币市场情绪。

《外交政策杂志》的报道将该进展描述为“威胁”而非已确认的决定。MSCI在2026年2月的审议中曾暂停将比特币储备公司剔除，但在2026年8月的审议周期中这一风险再度浮现。
summary.en:
According to a report dated August 29, 2026, Strategy (NASDAQ: MSTR) faces a renewed threat of removal from MSCI Global Equity Indexes. If removed, passive funds tracking these indexes would be forced to sell their MSTR holdings.

MSCI Global Equity Indexes are used by institutional investors worldwide for benchmarking and asset allocation. Removal would trigger forced selling by passive funds, putting downward pressure on MSTR, a widely watched Bitcoin proxy stock, and potentially dampening crypto market sentiment.

The report from Foreign Policy Journal describes the development as a 'threat' rather than a confirmed decision. MSCI previously paused the exclusion of bitcoin treasury companies in its February 2026 review, but the risk has resurfaced in the August 2026 review cycle.

title.zh: BitGo斥资4250万美元收购NYDIG机构交易部门
title.en: BitGo Buys NYDIG's Institutional Trading Arm for $42.5M

summary.zh:
BitGo已完成对NYDIG机构交易业务的收购，交易总额约4250万美元，增加了衍生品、结构化产品、融资和资本市场解决方案。该交易包含约30名员工，分两步完成合并，其中700万美元现金加约3550万美元BitGo股票。

此次整合增强了BitGo的交易平台，使机构能够在同一屋檐下获得托管、交易、融资和结算服务。这表明资产管理公司、对冲基金和家族办公室对数字资产全生命周期服务的需求日益增长，同时让NYDIG更专注于挖矿和高性能计算数据中心。

NYDIG的出售包含业绩对赌条款，包括与一项收入里程碑挂钩的1000万美元现金支付，以及与另一里程碑挂钩的至多500万美元现金和额外股份。NYDIG将专注于发电、比特币挖矿和高性能计算数据中心业务，其开发管道超过3吉瓦。
summary.en:
BitGo has completed the acquisition of NYDIG's institutional trading business for about $42.5 million, adding derivatives, structured products, financing, and capital-markets solutions. The deal includes roughly 30 employees and is structured as a two-step merger with $7 million cash and about $35.5 million in BitGo stock.

This consolidation strengthens BitGo's trading platform to offer institutions custody, trading, financing, and settlement under one roof. It signals growing demand for full-lifecycle digital asset services among asset managers, hedge funds, and family offices, and sharpens NYDIG's focus on mining and HPC data centers.

NYDIG's sale includes earnout provisions, including a $10 million cash payment tied to one revenue milestone and up to $5 million more plus additional shares tied to a second. NYDIG will concentrate on its power-generation, Bitcoin mining, and high-performance computing data-center business, which has a development pipeline exceeding 3 gigawatts.
